title: Flowing to free boundary minimal surfaces
summary: We introduce a flow that is designed to flow maps $u:Σ\to \mathbb{R}^n$ which map the boundary of a general domain surface $Σ$ into a given (not necessarily connected) submanifold $N\hookrightarrow \mathbb{R}^n$ towards a free boundary (branched) minimal immersion supported by $N$. In the case when $Σ$ is the unit disc $D$, this task can be achieved by means of the Plateau-flow introduced in the work [15] of the second author.
